I am an old woman, 57 years, and I farm this small barley plot near my house. I have no schooling but I know barley — my mother grew it, and I grow it the same way on our highland soil. I will put a little DAP if the cooperative brings it in time, because barley does better with some fertilizer, but urea is expensive and I use only a small amount. I keep my own seed from last harvest like always, and my sons help me weed and harvest; I cannot afford to hire workers for such a small plot.
